summary: Frontend E2E tested /admin/users new features: last activity (relative + absolute), IP display, online indicator, BAN user, UNBAN, BAN IP, search filter, and admin self-row safety. All 8 review scenarios passed. DB left clean (IP 203.0.113.55 unbanned via DELETE /api/admin/banned-ips).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminUsers.jsx (612 lines) is acceptable but approaches the 700-line module-split threshold; ban dialog + helpers could be extracted in a future refactor.
Polling interval load() every 30s re-fires the same request even if the tab is hidden — consider using document.visibilityState or SWR to avoid unnecessary admin API load.

isOnline() relies on local clock (Date.now() - last_active < 90s). If server and client clocks differ significantly, status may be misleading. Backend already returns ISO timestamps so this is acceptable for now.
